column1: # skill-lint Tier 2 baseline (#81, #102): per-skill exemptions with reasons.
# Swept 2026-11-26 over skills/eshu/*/SKILL.md; burned down from 29 rows to 0
# in #102 (following #101). Each row suppresses one Tier 2 advisory the linter
# would otherwise print. Tier 1 (SKILL001-005, SKILL009 >600 chars) is never
# suppressible: a malformed skill fails no matter what is listed here. NEW
# skills get no baseline entries: their advisories stay visible until the body
# earns them, so each row must name a skill that exists.
